description: This file defines a service class 'LoanReloadService' in the package 'org.apache.fineract.cob.service'. It implements the ReloadService interface for Loan objects, providing methods to check reload eligibility and perform the reload using a LoanAssembler.

classes.name: LoanReloadService
classes.description: A Spring component service that reloads Loan entities, implementing the ReloadService interface for Loan.

methods.name: canReload
methods.description: Checks if the input entity is an instance of Loan and thus eligible for reload.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the Loan entity by assembling it from its ID using LoanAssembler.
